The structure of Zr28Fe8Si8 (reduced formula Zr7Fe2Si2) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 44 atoms in the unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 44 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Zr-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Fe- and Si-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
